description: This file defines the 'GeoZone' controller class for managing event-based operations related to geographical zones within the OpenCart admin module. It handles adding, editing, and deleting geo zones by generating and scheduling associated tasks, as well as updating related country information.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Controller class for managing geo zone events in the administrator section of OpenCart.

methods.name: addGeoZone
methods.description: Generates tasks to update tax rate info and country info when a new geo zone is added.

methods.name: editGeoZone
methods.description: Updates tax rate info and country info based on modifications to an existing geo zone, including handling removed countries.

methods.name: deleteGeoZone
methods.description: Creates tasks to update tax rate info and remove country info when a geo zone is deleted.
